name: Application and API Orchestration
description: Coordinates the Flask dashboard across patient selection, model inference, SHAP, scenarios, Digital Twin exports, Stage 4 graph delivery, and local Ollama guidance.

name: Model and Data Workflow
description: Defines the authoritative BRFSS feature contract and retains the notebook-only path for training, evaluation, SHAP analysis, and dataset-linked scenarios.

name: Digital Twin and Explanation Services
description: Implements model-backed simulation, temporary patient graph assembly, validated local-LLM explanations, and patient-specific SMPL mesh generation and export.

name: Browser UI Layer
description: Renders the Flask/Jinja dashboard and supplies responsive styling and accessible Cytoscape interactions for the four research stages.

name: Validation and Test Layer
description: Verifies Stage 4 graph completeness and privacy boundaries together with Ollama evidence validation, safe fallbacks, and Flask integration behavior.

name: Infrastructure and Configuration
description: Packages and orchestrates Flask, Jupyter, Neo4j, notebook training, and SMPL export while managing dependencies, environment defaults, build exclusions, and private-safe handoff automation.

name: Research and User Documentation
description: Documents setup, operation, SMPL assets, research framing, validation evidence, limitations, and safe supervisor handoff for the prototype.
